title: Apple's $250 Million AI iPhone Settlement Is Coming Sooner Than Expected. Learn Who's Eligible for a Payout - CNET
summary: Apple is settling a lawsuit related to the delayed rollout of Apple Intelligence features. According to the settlement, Apple needed to provide the information about affected customers within five days of the settlement approval.
